seo.title: Herbal Tea Recipes | Govind Madhav Herbal Tea
seo.description: Explore hot and iced preparation recipes for Govind Madhav Herbal Tea, including Tulsi, Ginger, Herbal, Cough, Diabetic and Weight Loss Tea.

hero.title: Discover the Art of Brewing Herbal Tea
hero.lead: Explore delicious ways to prepare your favourite Govind Madhav Herbal Tea. From comforting hot cups to refreshing iced creations, find a preparation style for every moment.

intro.title: Six Herbal Blends. Endless Ways to Enjoy.
intro.lead: Every cup can be enjoyed your way. Explore the preparation instructions for our six herbal tea varieties and discover both warm and refreshing ways to serve them.

hotMilk.label: Hot with Milk
hotMilk.title: Hot Tea with Milk
hotMilk.body: Boiled in full cream milk for 2 minutes, strained and served hot.

hotWater.label: Hot without Milk
hotWater.title: Hot Tea without Milk
hotWater.body: Boiled in water for 2 minutes with a few drops of lemon juice, strained and served hot.

icedShake.label: Iced Milkshake
icedShake.title: Ice Cold Tea Milkshake
icedShake.body: Boiled in full cream milk, cooled, then shaken in a blender mixer with ice.

icedWater.label: Iced without Milk
icedWater.title: Ice Cold Tea without Milk
icedWater.body: Boiled in water, strained into an ice-filled glass and served ice cold.

collection.title: Our Herbal Tea Recipes
collection.lead: Choose your favourite blend and explore its preparation instructions.

restaurants.title: Serving Herbal Tea at Your Restaurant?
restaurants.lead: See our larger-batch hot and cold recipes for restaurants, cafés, snack corners and Govinda Restaurants.

product.title: How to Prepare
product.lead: Hot with milk, hot without milk, as an iced milkshake or iced without milk: step-by-step preparation for 1 cup.

weightLoss.name: Govind Madhav Weight Loss Tea
weightLoss.heading: Weight Loss Tea – Preparation Guide
weightLoss.intro: Four ways to prepare it, hot or iced, with milk or water. Sweeten with 1 or 2 sugar-free tablets.
weightLoss.viewLabel: View the Weight Loss Tea recipe
weightLoss.shopLabel: Shop Govind Madhav Weight Loss Tea
weightLoss.alt: Govind Madhav Weight Loss Tea pack
weightLoss.notes:
To make the tea: take 1 cup of full cream milk.
This tea can also be refrigerated for days.
This tea with milk or without milk can also be boiled again.
It will not lose its taste.
The herbs release more juice over time.
Add 1 or 2 sugar-free tablets to make it tasty.

tulsi.name: Govind Madhav Tulsi Tea
tulsi.heading: Tulsi Tea – Preparation Guide
tulsi.intro: Four ways to prepare it, hot or iced, with milk or water. Sweeten with sugar, honey or sugar-free tablets.
tulsi.notes:
To make the tea: you can take 1/2 cup of full cream milk and 1/2 cup of water.
This tea can also be refrigerated for days.
This tea with milk or without milk can also be boiled again.
It will not lose its taste.
The herbs release more juice over time.
Add sugar or honey or 1 or 2 sugar-free tablets to make it tasty.

weightLoss.hotMilk:
Boil 1 cup of full cream milk.
Add 1 spoon of tea (spoon provided in the pack).
A pinch of grated ginger can be added.
Boil for 2 minutes.
Strain and serve hot.
Add 1 or 2 sugar-free tablets to mask the bitter taste.
weightLoss.hotWater:
Boil 1 cup of water.
Add 1 spoon of tea (spoon provided in the pack).
A pinch of grated ginger can be added.
Boil for 2 minutes.
Add a few drops of lemon juice.
Strain and serve hot.
Add 1 or 2 sugar-free tablets to mask the bitter taste.
weightLoss.icedShake:
Boil 1 cup of full cream milk.
Add 1 spoon of tea (spoon provided in the pack).
A pinch of grated ginger can be added.
Boil for 2 minutes.
Strain and cool.
Shake in a blender mixer with ice added.
Serve as an ice-cold shake.
Add 1 or 2 sugar-free tablets to mask the bitter taste.
weightLoss.icedWater:

Strain and add to an ice-filled glass to serve ice cold.
